user.title: Apple HomeView
user.description: Leave the host empty to search the network. Choose how to get AirPlay credentials: pair with a PIN shown on HomeView, or import credentials saved by an earlier pairing.

pair.title: Enter the PIN
pair.description: A 4-digit PIN is now shown on {name}. Enter it here.

file.title: Import credentials
file.description: Path to a file that holds AirPlay credentials for this HomeView (one line).

error.no_credentials: No credentials found in that file.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect with these credentials.
error.no_remote_control: Connected, but the remote-control channel is not available.

abort.already_configured: This HomeView is already set up.
abort.invalid_pin: Pairing failed: the PIN was rejected or expired.

init.title: AirPlay speakers
init.description: Pick the media_player entity for each AirPlay output, so media_player.join and homeview.remove_members can use it. Extra lines: entity_id = output id.

remove_members.name: Remove speakers
remove_members.description: Remove AirPlay speakers from the group HomeView is playing to.

group_members.name: Speakers
group_members.description: media_player entities mapped in the options.

set_outputs.name: Set outputs
set_outputs.description: Set HomeView's AirPlay outputs to exactly these output-device ids.

output_ids.name: Output ids
output_ids.description: AirPlay output-device ids (see the airplay_outputs attribute).
